title: M2.4: Loop and automated-mail prevention
description:
Implement the automation filter of contract section 5: null return path, Auto-Submitted, Precedence bulk/list/junk, auto-reply headers, List-Id, delivery-status reports, mailer-daemon style senders, own X-Chatticus-Origin, hop counter above 3, per-thread cap of 5 consecutive bot replies without a human message, and bot-to-bot-by-email treated as an external guest send.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each header case drops the message from the turn path and is counted by reason
- Bounce reports are routed to delivery status, not to a turn
- Two simulated deployments answering each other stop at the hop limit
- A thread with five unanswered bot replies sends no sixth

Gherkin: features/external_loop_prevention.feature

Depends on: M1.8

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.

comments.text: M1 follow-up on PR 641: the M1 automation filter now drops own-origin, auto-submitted and bounce-report mail (counter inbound_automated_dropped), and linking an external identity equal to any route key is refused (identity_is_a_route, 422). The full filter, list mail and bulk precedence handling still belong here.
